commands.review_summary:
This PR adds Control UI `/label` and named `/new` handling via existing session labels, filters fallback or synthetic parents for new-chat creation, propagates labels through main-session reset, and adds focused UI/gateway tests.

PR surface: Source +96, Tests +369. Total +465 across 13 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection of current main shows Control UI `/new` ignores trailing args and there is no local `/label`, while PR head adds both paths on the existing label contract.

target.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI
target.body:
Closes #93422

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Control UI typed chat commands did not consistently create or rename sessions with the user-provided visible name. `/new Research Plan` could lose the intended name while creating or resetting a chat, and `/label <name>` was not reliably handled as a local Control UI session command.

## Why This Change Was Made

This routes Control UI session naming through the existing gateway `label` contract instead of adding a second writable naming field. The `/new <name>` slash-command flow now passes the typed label through the real `ChatPage` adapter into `sessions.create`, including the `session.dmScope='main'` reset-in-place path, and `/label <name>` patches the active session label. New-chat parent selection still avoids unknown, synthetic, and fallback main rows so session lineage stays tied to persisted sessions only.

The generated Swift protocol model is updated from the gateway schema after removing the proposed `displayName` create/patch inputs. The change intentionally stays within session naming and parent-selection behavior; it does not change model routing, auth, archive/pin semantics, or transcript storage format.

## User Impact

Users can create a named chat from the Control UI with `/new Research Plan` and see that label persist through the gateway session store and session list. Users can also rename the current chat with `/label <name>` without waiting for an active run to finish.

## Evidence

- Local gateway RPC proof captured after the patch: `sessions.create` accepted `label: "Research Plan"`, `sessions.list` returned the created session by that label, `sessions.patch` changed it to `"Work Plan"`, and the session store persisted the patched label.
- Focused gateway validation passed: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/server.sessions.create.test.ts src/gateway/server.sessions.reset-hooks.test.ts src/gateway/sessions-patch.test.ts` — 5 files passed, 199 tests passed.
- Focused Control UI validation passed: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/chat-page.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-state.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-commands.test.ts` — 4 files passed, 115 tests passed, including a real `ChatPage` adapter regression for typed `/new <name>` and typed `/label <name>` local patch coverage.
- Protocol and command validation passed: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.test.ts src/auto-reply/commands-registry.test.ts src/commands/sessions.test.ts` — 3 files passed, 96 tests passed.
- Swift protocol generation was rerun and verified idempotent after the schema update.
